?Court No. - 88
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 9093 of 2023

Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Dileep Kumar Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Sameer Jain,J.

Heard Sri Dileep Kumar Yadav, learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Ghanshyam Mishra,
learned brief holder for the State-respondent.

The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No. 593 of 2022, under Sections 171, 419, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC, Police Station- Bahjoi, District- Sambhal,
during pendency of the trial in the court below.

FIR of the present case was lodged against applicant and according to the FIR, when applicant was apprehended then he represented himself as a police constable and from his possession two fake police ID were recovered.

Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the entire allegations made against the applicant are totally false and baseless and except the recovery of alleged fake police ID, there is no other evidence against him on record on the basis of which it can be said that applicant ever represented himself as a police constable.

sentences.text: He further submitted that on the basis of false and fake recovery of two ID, applicant has been made accused in the present matter.

He further submitted that applicant was not having any previous criminal history but when he was arrested in the present matter then he was implicated in two other cases along with present one and criminal history of the applicant has been explained in paragraph no. 10 to the affidavit filed in support of the present bail application and applicant is in jail, in the present matter since 2.11.2022.

Per contra, learned AGA opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that from the possession of applicant two fake police ID were recovered and on the ID photograph of the applicant was pasted with the name of Sandeep Pal and in the ID it has been mentioned that applicant (Sandeep Pal) is a police constable but in fact real name of the applicant is Randheer Singh, therefore, from the recovery of the two fake police ID, it appears that applicant prepared the fake ID and he used the same.
I have heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the record of the case.

From the perusal of the record, it appears that when applicant was apprehended by the police then he introduced himself as a police constable and from his possession two police ID were also recovered and he represented himself as police constable Sandeep Pal but it was found that both the recovered police ID were fake one and real name of the applicant is Randheer Singh, therefore, it appears that applicant prepared two fake police ID in which his name has been mentioned as Sandeep Pal and in the fake ID his post was mentioned as police constable, therefore, considering the nature of allegation, in my view applicant is not entitled to be released on bail at this stage.
Accordingly the instant bail application is rejected at this stage.

Order Date :- 23.3.2023 KK Patel  Sandeep Pal @ Randheer Singh vs State Of U.P. on 23 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125973116/
